rationale: The agent verified the user by matching the provided email to the account and correctly identified the order and item. It validated variant availability, performed the exchange, and provided accurate follow-up details, including the correct refund amount ($54.84 − $46.85 = $7.99) and that instructions would arrive via email. However, the agent proceeded to execute the exchange (a write action) without first obtaining the user’s explicit confirmation after stating the exact change, which violates the policy requirement to confirm before any order-changing action. The agent also selected the gift card as the payment method without explicit confirmation. Because of the missing confirmation before the write, the conversation fails the policy compliance bar despite otherwise correct execution and information.
